material_systems.name: Door/Trim System — QL-3 Acrylic Enamel
notes: Use bonding primer selectively where burn-through, patches, or adhesion risk is present.
Two finish coats typical for durable interior door finish.

material_systems.name: Door/Trim System — QL-4 Modified Urethane Enamel
notes: Higher performance enamel; tighter application discipline and more likely sanding between coats in high-visibility situations.

material_systems.name: Door/Trim System — QL-5 Premium + Clear
notes: Premium system intended for showcase-level results. Consider clear coat where client expectations justify cost.
May require extra inspection/repair rounds and conservative labor assumptions.

coverage_profiles.profile_sensitivity_notes: Door profiles, edges, and small batches increase waste; sprayers and tray/roller waste can raise loss.
Higher discipline finish; rework risk slightly higher; expect modest additional loss.
Premium systems often have tighter windows and higher rework/handling overhead; assume higher waste.

consumable_usage_models.notes: Panel/french/louvered increase abrasive consumption; slab doors may use less if power-sanded efficiently.

usage_rate.notes: Brushing is heavier for cut-in areas, edges, and detail correction.
Only applicable when brush/roll chosen; spraying will shift consumables to tips/filters.
Represents average tip/filter wear for door spraying per day; refine later based on field data.
Masking needs increase in occupied environments and on French doors.

compatibility_rules.rule: If existing coating is glossy/hard enamel, degloss and/or use bonding primer in risk zones before finish coats.
compatibility_rules.risk: Adhesion failure (peeling/scratching) if finish coats applied directly over slick surface.
compatibility_rules.mitigation: Perform degloss/sanding and spot bonding primer; consider adhesion test prior to full production.

compatibility_rules.rule: When spraying in occupied homes, containment and masking must be elevated or switch to brush/roll.
compatibility_rules.mitigation: Use containment/plastic, controlled ventilation, or choose non-spray method.

compatibility_rules.rule: Louvers at QL-5 may exceed economically reasonable labor without explicit authorization.
compatibility_rules.risk: Underbidding due to geometry-driven labor and rework.
compatibility_rules.mitigation: Use conservative factors and consider a not-to-exceed clause or pre-approval threshold.

risk_notes: Premium finishes require disciplined prep and controlled conditions; schedule and environment must support cure/recoat windows.
Spray application increases protection requirements and cleanup burden.
assumptions: These are system-level templates; exact products/brands are chosen later via Material DB.
Spread rates are conservative placeholders pending calibration.
uncertainty_flags: Louvers and French door details can drive higher rework and consumable usage than averages.
